mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two distinct AuditEntry atoms to record the same Access — the canonical violation of append-only / immutability. The injection forces such a duplicate to exist, so AppendOnly (and FR-010, FR-012) must fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.forAccess = e2.forAccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the every-access-has-an-audit fact lets Alloy invent an Access with no matching AuditEntry. The injection forces this case, breaking AuditCompleteness, FR-008 and FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some a: Access | a.outcome = Permitted and (no e: AuditEntry | e.forAccess = a) }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact links Permitted outcomes to (a) an allowed role-endpoint cell and (b) an active care-team membership. Clearing it severs both. The injection produces an AuditOfficer with a Permitted RecordsLookup outcome — denied by the permission matrix and certainly not on the patient's care team — which violates LeastPrivilege, OwnershipBasedAccess and FR-006.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthorisationViolation { some a: Access | a.caller.role = AuditOfficer and a.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the response-shape rule lets Alloy assign a RecordSummary response to a Denied outcome, or a different shape to NotFoundOrDenied than to Denied. The injection forces a Denied access and a NotFoundOrDenied access whose response shapes differ — the canonical information-leakage counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some disj a1, a2: Access | a1.outcome = Denied and a2.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied and a1.response != a2.response }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact pins each audit entry's snapshot fields to the underlying access. Clearing it lets an AuditEntry record a different clinician than the one who actually performed the access. The injection forces that misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.clinicianSnapshot != e.forAccess.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the IG-only rule lets a non-AuditOfficer caller obtain a Permitted outcome on /audit/search. The injection produces such an attempt, violating FR-011 and the LeastPrivilege clause covering AuditSearch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditSearchViolation { some s: AuditSearchAttempt | s.caller.role != AuditOfficer and s.outcome = Permitted }
